settings.brandPhilosophy: We preserve memories, communicate impact and build legacies through our lens. We help individuals and organisations communicate their stories, showcase their value and connect with the audiences that matter.
settings.location: Cape Coast, Central Region, Ghana · Serving Nationwide & International Markets

enquiries.projectDescription: Annual healthcare symposium coverage and live broadcast to 800 international delegates.

projects.title: Youth In Action: Renewable Agriculture Initiative
projects.client: Global Reach & West African Development Fund
projects.summary: A multi-region documentary chronicling youth-driven micro-irrigation and solar engineering in Ghana, formatted for international donor summits and global broadcast.
projects.challenge: Documenting remote agricultural pilot communities across challenging rural terrain with minimal setup time while preserving authentic participant voices.
projects.solution: Deploying a lightweight cinema rig, dual-channel wireless lavaliers with ambient shotgun mics, and natural-light color science.
projects.impact: Directly contributed to securing a $1.2M phase-two donor expansion following presentations at international forums.

projects.title: West Africa Economic Summit & Leadership Plenary
projects.summary: Three-day flagship executive summit with 1,200 in-person dignitaries and 24,000 global streaming delegates. Full live broadcast and instantaneous press image dissemination.
projects.challenge: Zero latency tolerance, strict VIP protocol clearance, and simultaneous same-day media pack releases for national and international press outlets.
projects.solution: A 5-camera optical fiber livestream switcher, dedicated on-site color technician, and tethered photo delivery suite with press release photos available within 20 minutes.
projects.impact: Zero downtime across 28 broadcast hours, over 400 high-res executive headshots delivered on-site.

projects.title: The Royal Kente Symphony: Nana & Abena
projects.location: Cape Coast Beach Resort & Heritage Castles
projects.summary: A breathtaking union celebrating Akan heritage, bespoke royal kente craftsmanship, and a 600-guest candlelit evening gala captured with editorial precision.
projects.challenge: Preserving the richness of gold embroidery and warm candlelit ambiences under extreme contrast and dynamic crowd movements without harsh strobes.
projects.solution: Dual full-frame cinema cameras equipped with high-speed prime lenses (f/1.2 and f/1.4), subtle atmospheric fill lighting, and an aerial drone sequence during golden hour.
projects.impact: A 12-minute cinematic feature film and a curated 900-photo archival leather album delivered ahead of schedule.

projects.title: Elevated Identity: Studio Commercial & Digital Campaign
projects.summary: A high-fashion commercial campaign crafted for pan-African digital billboards, social platforms, and television broadcast.
projects.challenge: Conveying premium minimalism and modern African luxury across multiple format ratios (16:9 broadcast, 9:16 mobile reels, and ultra-wide OOH billboards).
projects.solution: Open-gate 6K anamorphic capture paired with calibrated DaVinci Resolve color grading to produce unified visuals tailored to every platform format.
projects.impact: Over 2.8 million impressions across West Africa and a 34% increase in online campaign conversions in Q4.

projects.title: Cape Coast Forts, Horizons & Historic Heritage Survey
projects.location: Cape Coast, Elmina, & Central Region, Ghana
projects.summary: Archival 4K aerial mapping and photographic documentation of coastal forts, historic sanctuaries, and emerging eco-infrastructure for national archives.
